correctness.rationale: Exact source equation (2.12) is independently differentiated and integrated using E[N(tau)/tau]=integral x^-1 Phi_y. The difference from half equals a positive-kernel integral of Q(2/x), where Q(T)=sum_border (2c_j-j)T^j. The 1-Lipschitz imbalance walk and sum_{h>=2}(h-1)/T^h=1/(T-1)^2 imply that the largest nonzero border imbalance determines Q(T) strictly for every T>=2, including T=2 via strict finite-tail inequality. Endpoint integrability and finite stopping time are proved; independent dynamic-program and finite exact sign checks corroborate the analytic formula. No finite test is used as an infinite proof.
